summary: Plan GRC platform workflows, migration, testing and reporting. Explore the five-day advanced course and build implementation-ready artefacts.
lede: Governance, risk and compliance technology training is for professionals who govern, configure or implement GRC platforms. It addresses the practical task of connecting risks, obligations, controls, evidence and reporting in platform workflows. Participants practise assessing requirements and fit, planning data migration and reconciliation, and designing workflows, access and reporting to support ongoing assurance.
audienceIntro: This advanced course is designed for professionals who govern, configure, implement or rely on technology that connects organizational risk, compliance obligations, controls, evidence and reporting.
modules: GRC Configuration, Access and Release Control
prerequisites: Recommended prior experience: working knowledge of organizational risk, compliance or internal-control processes, plus exposure to a GRC platform or a related implementation. No programming is required; API integration is addressed through requirements, architecture and test-planning artefacts rather than code.
